- memory_id "1000536": Team Dune is a two-person team as of 2025-07-21.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000530": Farah and Tomasz are the members of Team Dune as of 2025-07-21.  (about: Tomasz, Team Dune, Farah)
- memory_id "1000482" [constraint]: Changes to billing-api need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing-api)

- memory_id "1000443": The job scheduler's single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.  (about: job scheduler)

- memory_id "1000350": After the runtime upgrade, the job scheduler's cold start time tripled.  (about: job scheduler, runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000347" [decision]: Team Dune adopted a monthly game day as of 2025-04-23.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000293": Team Dune owns the job scheduler as of 2025-04-04.  (about: Team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000289": Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Farah for the job scheduler handover on 2025-04-04.  (about: Farah, Oskar, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000279": Farah is on call for Team Dune as of 2025-03-31.  (about: Team Dune, Farah)
- memory_id "1000259": The job scheduler depends on the flags service for per-job kill switches; if the flags service is down, the job scheduler is down.  (about: flags service, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000248" [decision]: Diego takes over the Cinder on-call pager from Yuki as of 2025-03-27.  (about: Yuki, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000245" [constraint]: billing-api can be released on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC; any other release time requires an exception.  (about: billing-api)
- memory_id "1000242" [constraint]: The job scheduler can be released on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC; any other release time requires an exception.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000213": Team Dune has a planning meeting every Wednesday.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000211" [constraint]: The reporting service has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000193" [constraint]: The webhooks service has a deploy window on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000091" [decision]: The first on-call rotation for Team Dune goes to Farah.  (about: Team Dune, Farah)
- memory_id "1000037": Team Atlas owns billing-api as of 2025-01-08.  (about: Team Atlas, billing-api)
Existing entity names: Team Dune, Tomasz, Farah, billing-api, Boreal, Ember, reports pipeline, job scheduler, Cinder, product catalog, Yuki, Diego, runtime upgrade, Oskar, flags service, reporting service, webhooks service, Team Atlas
